before.source: original manifest asset and asset probe

after.change: Rebuilt the outline shell from OSM way 1324500897, split its elevations into five floors, added repeated glazing and frames, two brick end accents, and a flat parapet. Preview-only ground, camera and lights are not in the saved asset.
after.source_outline: Matches all OSM ring vertices within float32 Blender mesh precision; model does not independently validate the OSM source.

validation.structural_footprint_match: PASS within 0.001 m; maximum node discrepancy 0.00005993 m from float32 mesh storage.
validation.placement: Direct world-coordinate massing; OSM transformed nodes are the placed input. No measured independent placement check.
validation.orientation: Rendered ring retains OSM sequence/orientation; no rotation edit was applied.
validation.height: Five story count supported; story module and overall height estimated.
validation.collection_library_link: PASS: expected collection linked into a fresh empty Blender file with 19 mesh objects.

unresolved_uncertainty: No independent surveyed or official geospatial footprint for this 2025 building was located; horizontal agreement is with the cached OSM outline used to construct the asset.
Five stories are source-supported, while story height, parapet, and total elevation remain estimates.
Facade bay spacing, window sizes, brick accent positions and widths, material colors, roof equipment, and courtyard landscape geometry are illustrative and not measured.

The architect source identifies a north public courtyard and a south private courtyard; this asset models the building wings that bound them but does not include surveyed courtyard paving or planting.
